seoTitle: Pennsylvania School Calendar 2026-2027: Start Dates, Holidays, Breaks & District Calendars
seoDescription: Find Pennsylvania school calendars for 2026-2027, including Philadelphia first day, holidays, winter break, spring break, professional development days, PDFs and downloads.
about:
Pennsylvania public school calendars are approved locally by each district, so first day of school, last day, holidays, winter break, spring break, professional development days, report card dates, parent conference days, and make-up day plans can vary across the state. The School District of Philadelphia publishes one of the state's most searched calendars because it serves families across the city and includes districtwide attendance dates, staff professional development, term dates, and major holidays.

Families should verify district calendars before making travel, childcare, transportation, or appointment plans. Districtwide academic calendars do not always include every school-specific event, athletics schedule, testing window, graduation ceremony, or emergency closure update. MySchoolDates organizes available Pennsylvania district calendar pages and links back to official district sources for verification.

faqs.a: Pennsylvania school start dates vary by district. Many districts begin in late August or early September, but families should select a district calendar below to confirm the official first day.

faqs.q: Are Pennsylvania school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Pennsylvania public school calendars are approved locally, so first day, last day, holidays, professional days, breaks, and make-up day plans can differ by district.

faqs.q: Where can I find the School District of Philadelphia calendar?
faqs.a: Use the School District of Philadelphia calendar page on MySchoolDates for SDP first day, last day, holidays, breaks, professional development days, PDF links, and calendar download options.

faqs.q: Do Pennsylvania districts use weather make-up days?
faqs.a: Many Pennsylvania districts reserve or revise make-up days after weather or emergency closures. Families should check the official district calendar and announcements before making end-of-year plans.

faqs.q: When is spring break for Pennsylvania schools?
faqs.a: Spring break varies by district and school year. Select a district calendar on this page to confirm the official dates.

faqs.q: Can I add a Pennsylvania school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. District pages on MySchoolDates include calendar download options when available, including ICS files that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
